description: FREE Community Forum: Bob Fioretti's SAFE-T Act Task Force – BolingbrookEarlier this year Bob Fioretti announced the creation of a new Illinois Public Safety & Accountability Commission, led by retired Riverside Police Chief Thomas Weitzel.
